body: **Review note (orchestrator):** the plan section caption in `src/pages/CodingReference.tsx` hard-codes *revision 2, saved 2 October 2026*. `plan.json` already carries `epic.revisionNumber` and `epic.savedAt`, and the plan view header shows the live revision. If a newer revision of this epic is ever saved and committed, the caption goes stale. This is not an acceptance-criteria failure. Your call whether to fix it in PR review (DGI-6) or leave it.
